conventions.score_direction: CRPS, ES and VS: lower is better
conventions.energy_norm: Euclidean over H; no division by H or sqrt(H)
conventions.variogram_weights: 1 for all ordered off-diagonal hour pairs; no normalization
conventions.intervals: central, pointwise, linear quantiles, inclusive endpoints
conventions.input_scale: unchanged; caller must use the same power units for all models
conventions.alignment: sample_id joined; zone, issue/valid times, split, unit and fingerprints checked

diagnostics.baseline: RAND: complete training trajectories sampled with replacement
